# cloudinary_product_environment (Resource)

Manages a Cloudinary product environment (previously known as a sub-account).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cloudinary_product_environment" "example" {
  name       = "Example Production"
  cloud_name = "acme-prod"

  # Optionally copy settings from an existing product environment (create-time only).
  # base_sub_account_id = "555asdf0000zxcvb3456qwerty"
}

output "cloud_name" {
  value = cloudinary_product_environment.example.cloud_name
}

# The access key auto-provisioned with the product environment. Its secret is
# only available at creation time.
output "initial_api_key" {
  value     = cloudinary_product_environment.example.initial_access_key.key
  sensitive = true
}

output "initial_api_secret" {
  value     = cloudinary_product_environment.example.initial_access_key.secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The display name of the product environment.

### Optional

- `base_sub_account_id` (String) The ID of an existing product environment to copy settings from. Only used at creation time; changing it forces a new resource.
- `cloud_name` (String) The Cloudinary cloud name. If omitted, Cloudinary auto-generates one.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the product environment is enabled. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the product environment was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of the product environment (sub-account).
- `initial_access_key` (Attributes) The API access key automatically provisioned together with the sub-account. Only populated when Terraform creates the sub-account; it is `null` after an import because the API does not identify which of a sub-account's keys was the original. The `secret` is only returned at creation time. To manage or read other access keys, use the `cloudinary_access_key` resource/data source. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--initial_access_key))

<a id="nestedatt--initial_access_key"></a>
### Nested Schema for `initial_access_key`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the access key is enabled.
- `key` (String) The API key.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) The API secret. Only populated at creation time.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Product environments can be imported by their ID...
terraform import cloudinary_product_environment.example 555asdf0000zxcvb3456qwerty

# ...or by their cloud name.
terraform import cloudinary_product_environment.example acme-prod
```
